message.subject: Question about protective film chemistry
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw 3M just launched the Protection Wrap Film Color Series—congrats on the rollout.

I'm reaching out because we're seeing more customers ask about the chemistry differences between PVF and vinyl-based protective films, especially for applications where they're pushing for warranties beyond the typical 8-9 year range.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about what we're seeing in the market? I think it could be valuable competitive intelligence for your team's roadmap planning.

Happy to share some technical insights if useful.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: 3M actively launching Protection Wrap Film Color Series while facing customer demands for extended warranties beyond current MCS program limits
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: PVF chemistry advantage enabling extended warranty capabilities beyond vinyl-based films
